notes.title: Leaderboard Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25427086/f8db74612f96f821987b57fd5d85cb5f6f029ddc.png[/img]

Your best score will be saved in the online database and the Leaderboard UI is now showing up after your game. [b] [Current Top Score: 129,000] [/b]

You can also see top score here: http://steamcommunity.com/stats/491100/leaderboards/1340402

[b]Update Notes:[/b]

-Leaderboard UI
-3D Button Bug fixed
-Game Reset After Game Over Bug Fixed

The [b]Official HTC Vive Controller Skin[/b] is now available too !
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=724150427
